d:
This will be my first attempt to juggle three stories at once (along with the mainline Possum Girl series and the current U-Maids series).

Herein, I'll do what obviously needed to be done by the Japanese entertainment industry a VERY LONG TIME AGO: Hooking perverted young college men with perverted of Christmas cakes.

I'll also hit on some serious subjects. The main one: "Being mix-raced in a society that'll gives you no quarters sucks to high heck."
